USDCraft-10K: Simulation-Ready Articulated 3D Assets in OpenUSD
	






  
  
  
  


USDCraft-10K is a dataset of simulation-ready rigid and articulated 3D assets in OpenUSD, built
with USDCraft (Geometrically Grounded Programmatic
Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation). USDCraft has a language model write each
object as an asset program, which is compiled into an articulated USD asset with parts, joints and
joint limits, collision geometry, masses and physics… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/USDCraft-10K.
